newsitem.title: USA: America West expects to meet Q4 estimates.
newsitem.headline: America West expects to meet Q4 estimates.

text.p: America West Airlines Inc Chief Financial Officer Douglas Parker said Friday the company expected to meet analysts' fourth-quarter earnings estimates now that it resolved operational problems that held back its third-quarter financial performance.

"Much of the problems that caused this revenue decline in the third quarter we believe are behind us ... and we are comfortable with current estimates for the fourth quarter of $0.20 to $0.22 a share," Parker said during a conference call.
"The reason we can make that statement is because our operational difficulties are largely improved and appear to be behind us," he said.

In the third quarter, America West tried to improve yields by increasing fares, Parker said. That was a "poor decision," he conceded, which hurt revenues and eroded the discount airline's competitive advantage in many markets, particularly with business travellers.
He said the airline has returned to its earlier discount strategy, adding that he expected ticket prices to be stable in the fourth quarter.
Completion rates were also held back by a bottleneck in the company's pilot training program, a problem the company has now resolved, Parker said.
To be sure, fuel prices, which drove up third-quarter costs, are expected to be even higher in the fourth quarter.
"Our fuel price estimate for the fourth quarter is about $0.75, which would be higher even than our third quarter, which averaged $0.67. That would be an increase of 26.5 percent," he said.

The chief financial officer said he hoped a new hedging program, adopted recently by the firm's board of directors, would help protect the airline from future increases in fuel prices. The program was approved too late to help in the fourth quarter, he said.
Earlier, America West reported a third-quarter loss of $45.7 million, or $1.03 a share, compared to a profit of $21.7 million, or $0.46 a share, in the year-ago period.
Results for the latest quarter included a pretax charge of $65 million. Without that charge the company would have posted pretax profits of $3.6 million or $0.04 a share.
